generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Jepson eFlora's account of the family (Wetherwax), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flowers strongly bilateral; corolla of 5 united petals, two-lipped, the upper lip 2-lobed (a beak, the galea, in paintbrushes), the lower 3-lobed; stamens 4, didynamous, on the corolla tube; ovary superior, of 2 carpels.
